description: Transferring the block of land where the Faculty of Visual Arts of the University of the Visual and Performing Arts is located, to the University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Faculty of Visual Arts of the University of Visual and Performing Arts is located on the Government land at No.46, Horton Place, Colombo 07, belonging to Kurunduwatta Grama Niladhari Division of Thimbirigasyaya Divisional Secretariat Division in the Colombo District. The University of Visual and Performing Arts should have the legal title to the land on which the Faculty is located in order to provide adequate physical facilities for the development of practical and academic skills of the approximately 643 students studying in the Faculty of Visual Arts. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, to transfer the state-owned block of land in extent of 0.6277 hectare currently occupied by the Faculty of Visual Arts, to the University of Visual and Performing Arts as a free Grant in terms of section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.
